OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

INTEL471_API_URL.description: Base URL of the Intel 471 REST API.

INTEL471_API_KEY.description: Intel 471 API key (HTTP Basic authentication password).

INTEL471_DARKNET_INITIAL_HISTORY_ALERTS.description: Unix epoch (seconds) of the earliest alert to import on the first run. Subsequent runs only fetch alerts newer than the previous successful run.

INTEL471_DARKNET_TLP.description: TLP marking applied to every entity created by the connector. One of 'CLEAR', 'WHITE', 'GREEN', 'AMBER', 'AMBER_STRICT' (or 'AMBER+STRICT'), 'RED' (case-insensitive).
